translations.web: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.
translations.bsb: Whoever keeps his command will come to no harm, and a wise heart knows the right time and procedure.
translations.kjv: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.
translations.asv: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall know no evil thing; and a wise man's heart discerneth time and judgment:
